action: Engine generates dataset samples every 5 minutes via a cron job, using the local fine-tuned model which has no rate limits and costs nothing.
The propose/verify engine uses the local fine-tuned model as the generator, with the free cloud lanes (OpenRouter free tier) configured as fallback only when the local model fails.
Fine-tuned model trained and adopted, deployed as a local lane, but no production traffic routed to it yet; routing build scheduled for later.
Launch timeline estimated as: capability layer 2-4 days, instructions 08-25, pilot 08-31, cohort 09-14, based on a sequential plan.
A background bridge service was deployed; it crash-looped 1273 times over an hour before being noticed during a user request.
Attestation heartbeat attests ledger rows after they are committed; nothing reviews changes before they ship.
